tracks.title: Theory
tracks.blurb: Understand the keyboard, notes, fingers and rhythm, one idea at a time.

milestones.title: The keyboard
milestones.goal: Find your way around the white and black keys.

lessons.title: White and black keys
lessons.goal: See how the keyboard is laid out.

pages.title: Low to high
text: Keys on the **left** sound **low**. Keys on the **right** sound **high**.
Every key has its own sound. Try a few!

check.prompt: Press any key to hear it.

pages.title: Groups of black keys
text: The black keys come in **groups of two** and **groups of three**.
These groups are your map: every white key can be found from them.

check.prompt: How are the black keys grouped?

lessons.title: Finding C and F
lessons.goal: Use the black-key groups to find notes.

pages.title: C sits left of two black keys
text: Find a group of **two** black keys. The white key just to its **left** is **C**.
There is a C in every octave.

check.prompt: Play any C.
check.name: C

pages.title: Middle C
text: The C nearest the middle of the keyboard is called **middle C**.
Most first songs start here.

check.prompt: Play middle C.

pages.title: F sits left of three black keys
text: Find a group of **three** black keys. The white key just to its **left** is **F**.

check.prompt: Play any F.
check.name: F

milestones.title: Note names
milestones.goal: Know the seven letters and find any white key.

lessons.title: The musical alphabet
lessons.goal: Seven letters that repeat.

pages.title: Only seven letters
text: White keys are named **A B C D E F G**, then the letters start again.
From C going right: C D E F G A B C.

check.prompt: Play any D (just right of C).
check.name: D

pages.title: Up and down
text: Moving **right** goes **up** (higher). Moving **left** goes **down** (lower).

check.prompt: Moving to the right makes notes…

pages.title: Octaves
text: Keys with the same letter sound alike, just higher or lower.
From one C to the next is an **octave** (eight white keys).

check.prompt: Play the C one octave above middle C.

lessons.title: Find the notes
lessons.goal: Find E, G, A and B by yourself.

pages.title: Find E
text: E is the white key to the **right** of the two black keys.

check.prompt: Play any E.
check.name: E

pages.title: Find G
text: G is between the first and second key of the three black keys.

check.prompt: Play any G.
check.name: G

pages.title: Find A
text: A comes right after G.

check.prompt: Play any A.
check.name: A

pages.title: Find B
text: B is the white key to the **right** of the three black keys.

check.prompt: Play any B.
check.name: B

milestones.title: Your hands
milestones.goal: Learn finger numbers and a good hand position.

lessons.title: Finger numbers
lessons.goal: Every finger has a number and a color.

pages.title: Numbers for fingers
text: Thumb **1**, index **2**, middle **3**, ring **4**, pinky **5**.
Songs tell you which finger to use with these numbers.

check.prompt: Which finger is number 1?

pages.title: Both hands match
text: The left hand uses the same numbers: thumb **1** to pinky **5**.
On the keyboard the left hand is a mirror image, so its thumb points right.

check.prompt: Your left pinky is finger…

pages.title: Colors help
text: In Keyflow each finger has a color: thumb red, index orange, middle yellow, ring green, pinky blue.
The badge on a falling note shows which finger to use.

check.prompt: A yellow badge on a note means…

lessons.title: Hand position
lessons.goal: Place your hands ready to play.

pages.title: C position
text: Put your **right thumb on middle C**, then one finger per key: C D E F G.
This is called **C position**.

check.prompt: Play G with finger 5.

pages.title: Curved fingers
text: Keep your fingers **curved**, as if holding a small ball.
Play with your fingertips and keep your wrists level and relaxed.

check.prompt: Your fingers should be…

pages.title: Left hand C position
text: Put your **left pinky on the C below middle C**, then one finger per key up to the thumb on G.

check.prompt: Play that C with your left pinky.

milestones.title: Rhythm
milestones.goal: Feel the beat and read note lengths.

lessons.title: Beats and note lengths
lessons.goal: How long each note lasts.

pages.title: The beat
text: Music has a steady pulse called the **beat**, like a ticking clock.
Turn on the metronome in a lesson to hear it.

check.prompt: A beat is…

pages.title: Long and short notes
text: A **quarter note** lasts 1 beat, a **half note** 2 beats, a **whole note** 4 beats.
In Keyflow, longer bars mean longer notes: hold the key until the bar ends.

check.prompt: How many beats does a half note last?

pages.title: Rests
text: A **rest** is a beat of silence. It counts just like a note.
In Keyflow a rest is the gap between bars.

check.prompt: During a rest you…

lessons.title: Black key names
lessons.goal: Sharps go up, flats go down.

pages.title: Sharp ♯ means up
text: A **sharp** (♯) is the key just to the **right**. C♯ is the black key right of C.

check.prompt: Play any C♯.
check.name: C#

pages.title: Flat ♭ means down
text: A **flat** (♭) is the key just to the **left**. B♭ is the black key left of B.

check.prompt: Play any B♭.
check.name: Bb

pages.title: Two names, one key
text: Each black key has two names. The key right of C is C♯, and it is also D♭ (left of D).

check.prompt: C♯ is the same key as…

milestones.title: Moving your hand
milestones.goal: Know when and how your hand moves, and read the hints.

lessons.title: Why hands move
lessons.goal: Reaches, thumb under, cross over and the hints that show them.

pages.title: Five fingers, many keys
text: One hand covers about **five keys**. Songs go further, so your hand has to move.

check.prompt: Without moving, one hand covers about…

pages.title: Reaching
text: A finger can **stretch one key** without moving the hand.
Keyflow shows this on the note as **+1 →** (reach one key right) or **← −1**.

check.prompt: Keep your thumb on C and reach your pinky to A.

pages.title: Thumb under
text: Going up a scale, after finger 3 the **thumb slides under** to the next key. The hand moves along with it.

check.prompt: Play F with your thumb, passing it under finger 3.

pages.title: Cross over
text: Coming back down, **finger 3 crosses over** the thumb, and the hand moves back.

check.prompt: Coming down a scale, which finger crosses over the thumb?

pages.title: Reading the hints
text: **+1 →** on a note: reach that finger one key to the right.
**Hand +4**: move your whole hand four keys to the right.
A **dashed outline** and the hand at the bottom show the move before it happens.

check.prompt: What does “+1 →” on a note mean?
options: Reach one key to the right

lessons.title: Three notes together
lessons.goal: What a chord is and how to play one.

pages.title: What's a chord?
text: A **chord** is three or more notes played together.
The C chord is **C E G**, played with fingers **1 3 5**.

check.prompt: Play C, E and G together.

pages.title: The F chord
text: Keep your thumb on C and play **C F A** with fingers **1 4 5**. That's an F chord.

check.prompt: Play C, F and A together.

tracks.title: Practice
tracks.blurb: Play real music, from your first keys to Für Elise.

milestones.title: First keys
milestones.goal: Play your first melodies with the right hand.

lessons.title: Meet Middle C
lessons.goal: C sits just left of the two black keys. Find every C.

lessons.title: Five Fingers
lessons.goal: Thumb on C, one finger per key, up and back down.

lessons.title: Mary Had a Little Lamb
lessons.goal: Your first song with three fingers.

lessons.title: Twinkle Twinkle
lessons.goal: Stretch to A for the "little star".

milestones.title: Both hands
milestones.goal: Bring in the left hand, then play with both.

lessons.title: Left Hand Walk
lessons.goal: The left hand plays low notes. Pinky starts on C.

lessons.title: Ode to Joy
lessons.goal: A famous melody in the right hand.

lessons.title: Ode to Joy: left hand
lessons.goal: Hold the bass notes while the melody plays for you.

lessons.title: Ode to Joy: together
lessons.goal: Both hands at once. Take it slow.

milestones.title: Rhythm
milestones.goal: Play in time as the notes keep moving.

lessons.title: Steady Beats
lessons.goal: Notes now keep moving. Hit them on the line.

lessons.title: Mary in Time
lessons.goal: The same song, now in real time.

lessons.title: Rests and Rhythm
lessons.goal: Silence is part of the music. Count the gaps.

lessons.title: Ode to Joy in Time
lessons.goal: Full tempo, real time.

milestones.title: Black keys and scales
milestones.goal: Use sharps and play your first scales.

lessons.title: Black Key Hop
lessons.goal: Groups of two and three black keys.

lessons.title: C Major Scale
lessons.goal: Cross your thumb under after E.

lessons.title: G Major Scale
lessons.goal: One sharp: F♯.

milestones.title: Chords
milestones.goal: Play three notes at once and add a bass line.

lessons.title: Three-Note Chords
lessons.goal: Press all three keys together.

lessons.title: Chords in Time
lessons.goal: Now change chords on the beat.

lessons.title: Chords with Bass
lessons.goal: Right hand chords, left hand bass.

milestones.title: Advanced
milestones.goal: Arpeggios and a real classical piece.

lessons.title: Rolling Arpeggios
lessons.goal: Spread the chord out, one note at a time.

lessons.title: Für Elise: right hand
lessons.goal: The famous opening, melody only.

lessons.title: Für Elise: together
lessons.goal: Both hands, no labels. You are a pianist now.

tracks.title: Hand moves
tracks.blurb: Train your hand to reach, jump and cross to the right key.

milestones.title: Reach without moving
milestones.goal: Stretch a finger one key while your thumb stays put.

lessons.title: Reach for It
lessons.goal: Thumb stays on C; fingers 4 and 5 reach to G and A (+1 →).

lessons.title: Twinkle Reaches
lessons.goal: Spot the +1 reaches in a song you know.

milestones.title: Jump to a new position
milestones.goal: Lift your whole hand and land on new keys.

lessons.title: Jump to G Position
lessons.goal: Move your hand four keys right, then back (Hand +4, Hand −4).

lessons.title: Octave Leap
lessons.goal: Jump a whole octave and back (Hand +7).

lessons.title: Frère Jacques
lessons.goal: A small hand move hides in the last line.

milestones.title: Thumb under
milestones.goal: Pass your thumb under to keep climbing.

lessons.title: Thumb Under and Back
lessons.goal: After finger 3, slide the thumb under onto F.

lessons.title: C Scale, Slowly
lessons.goal: Thumb under going up, cross over coming down.

milestones.title: Cross over
milestones.goal: Bring a finger over your thumb on the way down.

lessons.title: Cross Over
lessons.goal: From the thumb on F, cross finger 3 over onto E.

lessons.title: G Scale, Slowly
lessons.goal: Thumb under onto C, finger 3 over onto B.

milestones.title: Left hand moves
milestones.goal: The same moves, mirrored, in the left hand.

lessons.title: Left Hand C Scale
lessons.goal: Finger 3 crosses over going up; the thumb passes under coming down.

milestones.title: Moves in real music
milestones.goal: Use every move in a real piece.

lessons.title: Minuet in G, Slowly
lessons.goal: Hand moves, a thumb under and a cross over.

lessons.title: Minuet in G in Time
lessons.goal: Now keep the moves flowing at speed.
